svg.aria-label: Keep Claude Code running on your own Mac,and watch and control it from your phone / Each environment runs an agent that reports to Cloudflare every 60 s (outbound only) / Open the dashboard on your phone to see every environment (Cloudflare Access login) / When Remote Control drops, the dashboard turns red and Slack is notified / Tap to fix: the command waits in D1 and the agent picks it up on its next report / Start Remote Control for any folder from your phone, then continue in the Claude app
svg.text: Each environment runs an agent that reports to Cloudflare every 60 s (outbound only)
Open the dashboard on your phone to see every environment (Cloudflare Access login)
When Remote Control drops, the dashboard turns red and Slack is notified
Tap to fix: the command waits in D1 and the agent picks it up on its next report
Start Remote Control for any folder from your phone, then continue in the Claude app

g.text: Keep Claude Code running on your own Mac,
and watch and control it from your phone
Mac + up to 2 macOS VMs · start Remote Control remotely · runs on Cloudflare, no open ports
